acquisition.details: Completion audit found that watcher profiles accepted `claude-code`, `codex`, and `pi` harness values even though watcher execution only implements raw command profiles. Patched profile validation to reject non-raw watcher harnesses up front with guidance to use `eyes install claude-code`, `eyes install codex`, or `eyes install pi` for working-agent integrations. README now states that v1 watcher profiles execute through `harness = "raw"` and first-party harnesses are installed separately. Verification: cargo fmt --check; cargo test; cargo install --path . --locked --root /private/tmp/extra-eyes-install-check --force; installed-binary canary rejected a codex watcher profile with the expected guidance.
